root_cause.text: The vulnerability is caused by `led_classdev_register_ext` inserting the LED into the global `leds_list` before `led_init_core` initializes the `set_brightness_work` workqueue, allowing concurrent trigger registration to queue tasks on an uninitialized work structure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff moves the `list_add_tail(&led_cdev->node, &leds_list)` call to execute after `led_init_core(led_cdev)`, and the CVE description explicitly states this ordering previously left a window where `led_trigger_register` could call `led_set_brightness` which queues the *uninitialized* `led_classdev.set_brightness_work`.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement inserts the LED into the global leds_list before led_init_core initializes set_brightness_work. According to the root cause, this ordering allows concurrent trigger registration to queue tasks on an uninitialized work structure, creating a use-after-uninit-work vulnerability.
